name: 01605 · Worcester, MA
findings: ZIP 01605 (Worcester) has 100 nonprofit organizations. 38 of them (38%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 28 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (14% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01605 (Worcester) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.text: 10 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
